prompt:
You write the story panel. Write 4-6 plain-language sentences describing what the change does and what is and is not proven.
Every sentence must end with one or more claim references like [C1]. A sentence with no claim reference is invalid.
State facts, not opinions of quality. No confidence numbers.

sentences.text: The change targets issue #2283: the analyzer and the generator crash when a member's type is a closed generic struct defined in another assembly.
sentences.text_with_refs: The change targets issue #2283: the analyzer and the generator crash when a member's type is a closed generic struct defined in another assembly. [C1][C2]

sentences.text: The crash fix itself is two null-safe location lookups, and no live indexed DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] access is left in the file.
sentences.text_with_refs: The crash fix itself is two null-safe location lookups, and no live indexed DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] access is left in the file. [C1][C9]

sentences.text: The change also wraps every one of the 28 analyzer reporting call sites in a filter that silently drops any diagnostic whose location is not in the current compilation, which is far wider than the two patched sites.
sentences.text_with_refs: The change also wraps every one of the 28 analyzer reporting call sites in a filter that silently drops any diagnostic whose location is not in the current compilation, which is far wider than the two patched sites. [C4][C5]

sentences.text: Three new tests cover the struct and record-struct cases and assert both a clean build and an emitted resolver, but only 2 of the 6 declaration forms in the issue's table have a test.
sentences.text_with_refs: Three new tests cover the struct and record-struct cases and assert both a clean build and an emitted resolver, but only 2 of the 6 declaration forms in the issue's table have a test. [C2][C3]

sentences.text: README and the MsgPack004 page now say member problems in such types are reported by the defining assembly, and a code comment asserts what analyzers are not permitted to do; nothing in the change proves either statement.
sentences.text_with_refs: README and the MsgPack004 page now say member problems in such types are reported by the defining assembly, and a code comment asserts what analyzers are not permitted to do; nothing in the change proves either statement. [C6][C7][C8]

sentences.text: A helper documented as returning null only for metadata properties also returns null for source-declared record primary-constructor properties.
sentences.text_with_refs: A helper documented as returning null only for metadata properties also returns null for source-declared record primary-constructor properties. [C10]
